description: A `${…}` inside a code span or a fenced code block (`${HOME:-/tmp}`, `${DIR}`) is inert: it compiles with no scope error and is shown exactly as typed.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 Q21 "I like a." (what you type is what is shown)
rationale: §67.2 / §67.4: a slot the reader places inside a code span or a fenced code block (its body or its info string) is restored to its exact source text and is never parsed, name-resolved or scope-checked — a shell fence holding `${HOME:-/tmp}` compiles; no E-SCOPE-001.

expect.dom:
Set the directory with ${DIR}:

export TMP=${HOME:-/tmp} echo "${TMP}/cache"
